prompt:
[whispering, terrified] The footsteps went upstairs. Two hours till six. I turned the monitors down as dark as they'd go, and watched.

[quiet, tense] The lights came on on seven. Then on ten. She's walking the floors, flipping switches. Searching.

[whispering, terrified] The internal phone rang. If I pick up, she'll hear where I am.

[quiet, shaken] Twenty to six. The footsteps stopped. I don't know where she is. And that's the worst part.

[soft, sweet, whispering, uncanny] Ethan?.. I know you're here. I'm cold. Come out to me.

[whispering, very close, playful, uncanny] I can hear you breathing.
